description: This file is the __init__.py for the erpnext package, containing utility functions related to company defaults, regional settings, inventory, and memberships.

methods.name: get_default_company
methods.description: Retrieves the default company for a user, falling back to global defaults if user-specific defaults are not set.

methods.name: get_default_currency
methods.description: Returns the default currency of the default company.

methods.name: get_default_cost_center
methods.description: Returns the default cost center for a given company.

methods.name: get_company_currency
methods.description: Returns the default currency for a specified company.

methods.name: set_perpetual_inventory
methods.description: Enables or disables perpetual inventory for a company.

methods.name: encode_company_abbr
methods.description: Encodes a name with the company's abbreviation.

methods.name: is_perpetual_inventory_enabled
methods.description: Checks if perpetual inventory is enabled for a company.

methods.name: get_default_finance_book
methods.description: Retrieves the default finance book for a company.

methods.name: get_party_account_type
methods.description: Returns the account type for a given party type.

methods.name: get_region
methods.description: Returns the default country based on flags, company, or global settings.

methods.name: allow_regional
methods.description: Decorator to make a function regionally overridable based on the current region.

methods.name: get_last_membership
methods.description: Returns the last membership record for a member if it exists.
